repair_prompt: The original question is a yes/no question. Restate your last answer as exactly one JSON object with "answer" equal to "Yes" or "No" and "reason" one short sentence. Preserve your interpretation of the original question and image; do not add new clinical assumptions. Do not request tools or add text outside the JSON object.
fallback: Retain exact historical M answer/reason/status if known received reply is invalid.
unknown_sent: Stop, preserve intent, no automatic retry.

budget.accounting: Per-request usage; inherited M cost is not new spend.
